Description:
I really liked the orinal mod ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3831]CP Wooden Trailer Home[/url], by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/41636035]JazzMinK[/url] who has replaced the farmers home with a trailer) and I like Pam, she deserves better.
So I quickly adapted it to work for her.


All credit goes to the original author.
